entities.summary: Marvin Mitchell is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tennessee Volunteers and was selected by the New Orleans Saints in the seventh round of the 2007 NFL draft. Mitchell also played for the Miami Dolphins and Minnesota Vikings.
